Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer clicked a broad citywide directory (dojos.info) instead of focusing on options within a five-minute walk of the NYSE, then failed to verify walking distance or evening class times and got sidetracked by ads. This led to selecting schools over a mile away (Alliance Jiu Jitsu, NY Jidokwan Taekwondo) and missing the correct nearby option, Renzo Gracie Jiu-Jitsu Wall Street.
